items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: I was playing in the WPA band. Now, one of the first men in that band, I, uh, Adolph Alexander, a fella by the name of Garnier, and Tilna, Wilma Tilna.

ctx.x: No, Billy, Billy, Billy, uh, piano, play the piano. Did he his wife? Billy, yes. Billy, Billy Pierce. Billy, Billy Pierce. That's the name of Billy Pierce. Yeah, that's right. Well, she was playing with us. So, after that, you know, before that, that, uh, I was playing in the WPA band. Now, one of the first men in that band, I, uh, Adolph Alexander, a fella by the name of Garnier, and Tilna, Wilma Tilna. Did you play saxophone? Did you play saxophone then? So, we used to play back there on Claiborne Street in the…
Were you allowed to take outside jobs in that WPA band, or was that part of the, uh, project?
